payload.name: Include plan memories when answering about future plans
payload.description: When the user asks when or about a planned future event (e.g., planning, plans, going to, intends), include 'plan' memory kind in the search and resolve relative time phrases like 'next summer' from the memory or session timestamp.
content: If the question asks about a future plan or intention (e.g., 'when is X planning...', 'plans for', 'going to'), include memory_kind 'plan' in the search instead of restricting to 'event'.
When a retrieved plan memory expresses relative time (e.g., 'next summer', 'this weekend'), resolve it to a concrete date using the memory's world_start or the session timestamp before answering.

solves: Questions about planned future events are searched with only the 'event' memory kind, so 'plan' memories holding the intended date are missed and the agent answers from an unrelated nearby event. Apply when a user query uses planning language (e.g., 'planning', 'plans', 'when will') and asks for a date/schedule; include 'plan' memories and resolve relative time expressions from the memory's timestamp. Do not apply when the question concerns a past or purely factual event, where the default 'event' search suffices.
